lifted_by: json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode two times from the byte after the 'cells' array's opening bracket; the span is the bytes those two elements occupy, separators and whitespace included, with no trailing comma
source: src/tessera/serving/runtime_contract.json at contract_version 22 (origin/master 3ec01f26); re-spanned at contract_version 24 (#460) and again at 31 (tessera#538), without re-measuring any surviving cell; re-spanned at 32 (tessera#506 leg 2) when the E2M1_K2 dense cells' rungs_q256 widened to the full trellis domain, again without re-measuring — the two E4M3 routed cells in the span are untouched; re-spanned a second time at 32 (tessera#560 D2) when the dense widen was reverted to [896] for lack of a dense receipt, and the dense batch cell's KL entry stamped q256 896, the rung its 2026-09-02 receipt measured; re-spanned at 38 (tessera#604) to the first two elements when the two E4M3 routed cells were withdrawn -- the two surviving E2M1_K2 dense cells' span hashes identically on origin/master at contract_version 37 (2370 bytes, f4734cbe...), so no surviving cell was edited; re-spanned at 39 (tessera#604, second half) to NO elements when the two surviving E2M1_K2 dense cells were withdrawn -- no v22 sm_121 cell survives, so the span is empty and its digest is the empty string's
what: The v22 sm_121 cells that SURVIVE at contract_version 39, recorded as a digest. Contract v22 published ten; v31 withdrew six (tessera#538), v38 two more (tessera#604) and v39 the last two (tessera#604, second half). None is left: the span is empty, and the withdrawal lists below are what this fixture still carries.
why_not_the_bytes: A copy of the array would repeat the runtime image pin, and tests/test_runtime_image_pin.py refuses a second copy of that digest in any file that acts. A hash pins the same bytes without holding the pin.
withdrawn_why: They attested the dense window-GEMV lane. Commit 1b767a207 left fp8_route.apply and bf16_route.apply making one launch each -- tessera::window_gemm_dense/native_window_gemm -- so the build could no longer make the arithmetic these cells published, and every receipt behind them predates that commit. A withdrawal is neither an addition nor a re-measurement, so it is named here rather than absorbed into a new digest.
reearned_why: Contract v34 (tessera#545) re-attests the sm_121 BF16 dense scope on a served census of the native window GEMM (docs/measurements/tessera-window-gemm-census-2026-09-21.md), so two of the six withdrawn ids are shipped again. An id is a SCOPE -- validate_serving_contract derives it from (family, structure, platform, regime) and refuses any other spelling -- so re-attesting a scope reuses its id by construction; what is new is the CLAIM. The v34 cells execute tessera::window_gemm_dense/native_window_gemm, never the window-GEMV arithmetic 1b767a207 retired, and they are eager-only where the withdrawn pair covered eager and compiled. The other four ids stay absent: the e4m3 four split a scope by residency, which the v34 cells do not.
withdrawn_at_v37_why: Contract v37 (tessera#614) withdraws the two ids v34 re-earned. The BF16 route moved from the epilogue arithmetic (the fp32 accumulator times the row scale) to the folded one (one bf16 rounding of value * row_scale per weight, before the dot) and stamps its own decoder, native_window_gemm_folded; the v34 census measured the epilogue kernel under native_window_gemm, so the cells named an arithmetic the build no longer makes for BF16. Neither was in this span, so the digest does not move.
withdrawn_at_v38_why: Contract v38 (tessera#604) withdraws the two routed E4M3 cells on eugr/spark-vllm@sha256:0afec8d4... at q256 1024. They named (vllm.fused_moe.modular_kernel, torch_materialize_stock), which this build cannot make for an FP8 expert stack: moe_route.compact_window_lane answers True for FP8 whenever scheme.parse_compact_tessera_expert_blob exists, and it does. The launch leaves scheme.ROUTE_LAUNCHES in the same change.
reearned_at_v38_why: Contract v38 mints resident-scoped cells on the GLM serving image from a TP1 eager route census (docs/measurements/tessera-glm-x-census-2026-09-26.md). Two of the ids are E4M3 dense ones v31 withdrew, now executing tessera::window_gemm_dense/native_window_gemm on q256 832/1024/1088; two are the routed ids this version withdraws, now executing tessera.native_window_moe.NativeWindowMoE.__call__/native_window_moe_compact at q256 896 on another image. An id is a SCOPE, so re-attesting a scope reuses its id; the withdrawn CLAIMS do not come back.
withdrawn_at_v39_why: Contract v39 (tessera#604, second half) withdraws the two E2M1_K2 dense cells on the serve-image pin, which named (torch._scaled_mm, native_span2) -- nvfp4_route always prepares native A4 units and runs tessera.kernel_a4.a4_span2_gemm, so the build cannot make that pair -- and the two routed E2M1_K2 cells on spark-vllm-nccl230@sha256:a5424378..., which named (vllm.fused_moe.modular_kernel, torch_materialize_stock), a launch nvfp4_moe_route cannot make either. Both launches leave scheme.ROUTE_LAUNCHES in the same change. The dense pair were this span's last two elements; the routed pair were never in it.
reearned_at_v39_why: Contract v39 mints resident-scoped E2M1_K2 cells on the GLM serving image from a TP1 eager route census of an all-E2M1 eight-layer GLM-5.3-Flash stub (docs/measurements/tessera-glm-u1-census-2026-09-26.md). The two routed ids are the ones this version withdraws, now executing tessera.kernel_a4.a4_span2_grouped_gemm/native_span2_grouped at q256 896 on another image. The dense scope comes back under the resident-scoped ids tessera_e2m1_k2_dense_sm121_{decode,batch}_resident, executing tessera.kernel_a4.a4_span2_gemm/native_span2_gemm; the pin-image ids stay absent. An id is a SCOPE; the withdrawn CLAIMS do not come back.
remeasured_at_v42_why: Contract v42 (tessera#640) adds a second launch to the two routed E4M3 ids v38 re-earned -- tessera.routed_fused.FusedRoutedWindowMoE.__call__/native_routed_fused_window, the fused warp-specialised routed window lane the dispatch takes by default for every rate-4 window-14 expert stack -- on a served TP1 eager route census of the rate-4 u1 stub B on the GLM serving image (docs/measurements/2026-09-28-routed-fused-640.md). The compact launch stays: it serves every stack the lane refuses and TESSERA_ROUTED_FUSED=0. Neither id was in this span, so the digest does not move; a re-measurement is named here rather than absorbed.
remeasured_at_v43_why: Contract v43 (tessera#692) adds a second launch to the two E4M3 dense ids v38 re-earned -- tessera::fused_window_dense/native_fused_window_dense, the fused window kernel's DENSE identity (E = 1, identity routing, a split over K for decode), which the dispatch takes for every q256 1024 dense module of the window families -- on a served TP1 eager route census of the rate-4 u1 stub B on the GLM serving image (docs/measurements/2026-09-28-dense-fused-window.md); the same census earned the folded pair for the two BF16 resident dense ids, which were minted at v38 and never in this fixture. The Triton pair stays: it serves every module the lane refuses and TESSERA_DENSE_FUSED=0. Neither id was in this span, so the digest does not move; a re-measurement is named here rather than absorbed.
remeasured_at_v45_why: Contract v45 (tessera#694) changes the kernel behind both fused launches -- its word stages are sized per launch from the pair's larger rate (routed_fused.slot_words_for_pair), the odd-rate halves are copied in 16-byte pieces, and the previous window word is loaded for every 8-row group whose window starts inside the half's first word -- and widens the two lanes' published predicate from rate 4 to column_rates 1..8 with a structure-scoped column_rates_routed_moe 1..6 (the gate/up two-table launch does not fit sm_121's 101,376 B above rate 6). The four E4M3 ids v42 and v43 re-measured are re-measured again on the changed kernel: a served TP1 eager route census of the u1 stub B on the GLM serving image records the fused pair on its q256 1024 stacks and modules as before AND on its mixed-rate stacks (E4M3 at q256 896, 928 and 1088) and dense modules (q256 832, 880, 960 and 1088), which took the compact adapter / Triton window GEMM at v42/v43, and the two pinned-image dense censuses (resident, streamed) record it on 112/112 modules again (docs/measurements/2026-09-28-mixed-rate-fused-window.md). The cells' executes lists do not change -- each already named the fused pair beside the compact/Triton pair -- so no id is withdrawn or re-earned and the digest does not move; the re-measurement is named here rather than absorbed.
